services.desc: Whether you are just starting out or looking to expand your painting practice, TSA can help propel you to the next level. Our courses are designed to fit your lifestyle - with classes available during the daytime, evenings and weekends, as well as specialty painting workshops throughout the year. Our courses:- Absolute Beginner & Introductory painting (build foundational skills in colour, form and brushwork) - Portrait and figure painting (work directly with live models) - Still life and observational painting - Botanical, landscape and floral painting - Abstract and contemporary painting - Explore Oils, acrylics or watercolour painting At TSA, you’ll learn in fully equipped studios within
